Fail.

- `README.md:176` says “Markdown stays the source of truth” for addressable items. This contradicts the configured item model: invariants, rules, and gates are registry-first and sourced from `.jit/invariants.toml`, `.jit/rules.toml`, and `.jit/gates.toml`. Remediation: state that each item kind’s configured source is authoritative—Markdown for markdown-first kinds and TOML registries for registry-first kinds—while the item index remains a projection.
